evidence.description: Before (head d06ecc1): lane_pair carried headline_outcome, lane_1_outcome, lane_2_state, lane_2_reasons, and display only - no basis for any recorded act, and the docs described lane 2 as 'where human review and acceptance stand', presenting human acceptance as the standing path. The engine (1.6.0) already exposes the recorded acts: assessed claims carry stage_events with kind, author, date, and basis, and the engine reserves explained/accepted/digested advances to named people while a checked event defaults its recorder to aee.

After: _acceptance_basis copies each assessed claim's stage_events into lane_pair.acceptance_basis as recorded_acts (claim_id, to_stage, basis_type, recorded_by, basis) with test_verdict_count, human_act_count, and a display count line; basis_type is 'human act' for explained/accepted/digested or any person-recorded act, else 'test verdict'; no recorded acts yields null. Verified by tests/test_lane_outcomes.py (stub pair with one act of each type, classification unit test) and against the real engine 1.6.0 through the runner: a bundle staged to checked by aee with basis 'Frozen requirement tests passed: widget round-trip test suite run and assessed' displays 'acceptance basis: 1 test verdict(s), 0 human act(s)' with that act and basis text. README, the assess and gate command documents, and docs/usage.md present acceptance as test-verdict-first with human acts as the reserved cases.

falsification_tests: Run the runner's assess on an engine assessment whose claims carry stage_events and observe lane_pair without acceptance_basis, an act whose basis_type disagrees with the engine's rule (explained/accepted/digested or person-recorded = human act; tool-recorded checked = test verdict), or a basis text other than the recorded one; or read the README, assess/gate documents, or usage docs and find acceptance presented as a human act by default.
